extras.approval_status: APPROVED by project owner 2026-08-27, per plan.md decision D7. Core coalition facts (government_groups_citation below) approved as-is. Both open questions resolved — see resolved_questions: the 'nezarazeni' org was left out of government_groups (conservative default, no citation for coalition alignment), and Štefan's post-SOCDEM status follows the same resolution.

government_groups_citation.claim: Brno's 2022-2026 governing coalition, formed after the Oct 2022 election, is ODS+TOP09 ('ODS a TOP 09') + ANO 2011 + KDU-CSL+STAN ('Lidovci a Starostove') + CSSD ('CSSD VASI STAROSTOVE', later renamed 'SOCDEM' nationally in 2023) — 42 of 55 seats. Piraty (Pirati) pulled out of coalition talks hours before the signing ceremony over police raids connected to a corruption case; they, SPD+Trikolora, and Zeleni a Zit Brno sat in opposition instead.

The CSSD/SOCDEM identity change (idPolitickySubjekt 14 -> 9 in the feed) is a party rebrand, not a coalition change: the single councilor tracked under this klub (Bretislav Stefan, source id 98) has a continuous, non-overlapping transition from 'CSSD VASI STAROSTOVE' (2022-10-20 to 2023-06-20) to 'SOCDEM' (2023-09-05 to 2026-01-20) in the feed's own data, consistent with CSSD's real, publicly documented 2023 national rebrand to SOCDEM.
sources: brno.zastupko.cz/zastupko.fit.vutbr.cz feed itself (zastupitele[98].politickeSubjekty) — internal source-data citation, not an external news claim

government_groups_citation.claim: December 2025: ANO's national leadership expelled 10 Brno councillors (including deputy mayor Rene Cerny and councilor Petr Borecky) for refusing to leave the ruling coalition with ODS after the party's regional leadership called for it, following the Pavel Blazek bitcoin-seizure scandal. The expelled group EXPLICITLY STAYED in the governing coalition (that refusal is why they were expelled) and founded a new movement, 'Brno klidem', continuing as coalition members under that new banner. This is corroborated by the feed's own data: all 6 people who show a 'Nezavisli' (idPolitickySubjekt 7) interval have the IDENTICAL 2026-01-20 to 2026-03-03 window (a uniform transitional bucket, not scattered unrelated departures), and the same 6 (where recorded) later show 'Brno klidem a nezavisli zastupitele' (idPolitickySubjekt 16) from 2026-04-14 onward.
sources: https://www.brno.cz/w/petr-borecky (official council page, confirms Borecky's CURRENT affiliation as 'Brnoklidem a nezavisli zastupitele')

resolved_questions.question: Three people (Jiri Oliva id 21, Marek Viskot id 24, Bretislav Stefan id 98) show a 'nezarazeni' (unaffiliated, idPolitickySubjekt 15) interval starting 2026-03-03 — the exact date the 6-person 'Nezavisli' transitional bucket ends. Oliva and Viskot both have an assembly start of 2022-10-20 with NO earlier recorded party interval (same 'incomplete history' pattern as the confirmed ex-ANO group), suggesting they may ALSO be part of the same ex-ANO/coalition-loyal group but chose to go formally independent rather than join 'Brno klidem'. No citation found either way. Should 'nezarazeni' be added to government_groups, or left out?
resolved_questions.resolution: RESOLVED 2026-08-27 by project owner: left OUT of government_groups (the conservative default in the original draft recommendation) — do not assume coalition alignment without a citation. All three people's post-2026-03-03 votes count as opposition/independent for govity purposes until a citation says otherwise.
resolved_questions.reopen_if: A future re-check (see check_roster_overlay_staleness.py's pattern, not yet built for Brno) finds a citation confirming or denying these three people's coalition status.

resolved_questions.question: Stefan's own SOCDEM interval ends 2026-01-20 and he shows 'nezarazeni' from 2026-03-03 onward. Did Stefan leave the coalition when he left SOCDEM, or does he remain a coalition-aligned independent?
resolved_questions.resolution: RESOLVED 2026-08-27: same disposition as the question above — SOCDEM's historical membership stays in government_groups (it WAS a coalition partner for its whole recorded tenure, 2022-10-20 through 2026-01-20), but Stefan's post-2026-03-03 'nezarazeni' status does not count as government (same conservative default, no citation).

extras.not_investigated: Whether any of the 4 original coalition parties' own internal composition changed (e.g. ODS/TOP09 splitting) is out of scope, matching Praha's own definition's equivalent note — this repo models each feed-reported klub as one org, no sub-party split available.
